title: Fantasy X
tagline: A fantasy gaming application similar to fantasy football but geared towards the e-sports scene.
description: This project provides a platform which allows anyone to implement a blockchain version of their favorite fantasy sport. The professional players are represented by NFT's with dynamic properties that vary depending on how their perform in the real world. This is achieved through a custom Chainlink External Adapter.
how_its_made:
create-react-app, truffle, ganache, serverless, gcp cloud function, chainlink EA, Solidity, open zeppelin.



This is only a skeleton but already constitutes an end-to-end proof of concept. The smart contract only allows for minting but we would like to extend the functionality to buying and trading those NFT's. Also the logic for composing teams and onchain bidding is missing in this first iteration.
